decisions.reason: Changing the battery connector series, pitch, and pinout does not itself alter the confirmed placement, orientation, mounting-hole clearance, or spacing requirements.
The battery connector interface decision does not change the GPIO-switched 5V sensor rail, its converter, enable behavior, voltage, or powered loads.
The selected battery connector interface does not necessarily change the board dimensions, aspect ratio, mounting holes, USB-C position, or enclosure-fit requirements.
The JST-PH selection is motivated by common battery compatibility but does not change the existing general sourceability policy or the USB-specific availability and cost constraints.
